basis.governing_question: How can Metalúrgica Norte cut conversion cost across its six plants in Portugal and Spain and put the improvements in place in every plant?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish the conversion cost per part baseline in each of the six plants and size the improvement opportunities.

gate.label: Go/no-go on rollout
gate.decision: Go or no-go on rolling out the prioritized initiatives in the six plants?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Roll out the approved improvements to all six plants in waves and track conversion cost per part against baseline.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Approve the plant results against the success criteria as the final outcome?

architect_notes: Length of 18 to 22 weeks is an estimate based on six plants in two countries and the archetype's typical weeks; confirm before quoting.
No Measurement phase: the archetype tracks results inside Implementation; confirm whether the client wants separate tracking after launch to prove the per-part cost reduction.
